4-Day Classical Greece Tour: Olympia, Delphi & Meteora
summary:
The 4-Day Olympia, Delphi & Meteora Tour follows one of mainland Greece’s classic historical routes, linking the Peloponnese with central Greece in four days. Travel through Mycenae and Epidaurus, with a stop in Nafplio, before continuing to Ancient Olympia and Delphi. The final stage reaches Meteora, where centuries-old monasteries stand on immense natural rock formations, creating a striking contrast to the archaeological sites visited earlier.
This year-round circuit is designed around consecutive touring days rather than an Athens-based stay. The program includes selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, entrance fees, transfers and the sightseeing listed in the itinerary.

itinerary.title: Athens to Olympia via Nafplion
itinerary.text:
Depart via the coastal road with a short stop at the Corinth Canal.
Continue to Ancient Theatre of Epidaurus, famous for its remarkable acoustics.
Photo stop at Nafplio before visiting Mycenae and the Tomb of Agamemnon.
Drive through Tripolis and Megalopolis to Olympia. Overnight in Olympia.

itinerary.title: Olympia to Delphi
itinerary.text:
Morning visit to Ancient Olympia.
Including the Sanctuary of Olympian Zeus, Ancient Stadium and Archaeological Museum.
Continue through the plains of Elis and Achaia and cross the Rio–Antirrio Bridge.
Pass through Nafpaktos and Itea before arriving in Delphi. Overnight in Delphi.

itinerary.title: Delphi to Kalambaka
itinerary.text:
Morning visit to the Archaeological Site of Delphi and the Delphi Archaeological Museum.
Continue to Kalambaka, located at the foot of the impressive Meteora rock formations. Overnight in Kalambaka.

itinerary.title: Meteora to Athens
itinerary.text: Visit Meteora and its famous monasteries perched on towering rock formations. Return to Athens via Trikala, Lamia, and Thermopylae with a short stop at the Leonidas Monument. Arrival in Athens in the early evening.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 4-Day Greece Classical Mainland Tour?
faqs.a: The 4-Day Greece Classical Mainland Tour covers Olympia, Delphi, Meteora, and Kalambaka. You will visit some of Greece's most important historical and cultural landmarks, including the birthplace of the Olympic Games, the ancient sanctuary of Delphi, and the spectacular monasteries of Meteora. The tour runs for 3 nights and 4 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 4-Day Greece Classical Mainland Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €728 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, transportation between destinations, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: What are the main attractions included in the tour?
faqs.a: The tour includes the archaeological site of Olympia, the Sanctuary of Apollo at Delphi, the breathtaking monasteries of Meteora, and an overnight stay in Kalambaka, the charming town located beneath Meteora's towering rock formations.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 3 nights at carefully selected hotels with daily breakfast. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and convenient locations near the major attractions included in the itinerary.

faqs.q: Does the 4-Day Greece Classical Mainland Tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who are interested in Greece's history, archaeology, and religious heritage. It provides an excellent introduction to some of the country's most important UNESCO World Heritage Sites and ancient landmarks.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, climbing some steps at Meteora monasteries, and navigating uneven terrain. Most travelers with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Olympia, Delphi, and Meteora?
faqs.a: Olympia is famous as the birthplace of the ancient Olympic Games. Delphi was considered the spiritual center of the ancient Greek world and home to the Oracle of Apollo. Meteora is renowned for its stunning monasteries perched atop towering rock formations, offering some of the most spectacular scenery in Greece.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Greece Classical Mainland Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 4-Day Greece Classical Mainland Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year and can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include additional destinations, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
